text:
mira: ok small crisis: found a YAML config that tried to do semver flirting. compiler sent an apology email. :grimacing:

mira: here's the offending snippet:
```yaml
service:
  name: widget-service
  version: 1.0-beta-ish
  deploy: yes
```

josh: that version is committing crimes against parsing. it's like semver, but make it fashion. :tophat:

ara: rules reminder: YAML does not do ambiguity. it will judge you for `- ish`. :point_up:

linus: propose a speed-dating format: semver must present MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and bring receipts. anything else gets left on read. :laughing:

mira: honestly the funniest part was the CI reaction: it exploded beautifully.

build-bot: CI notice — pipeline "deploy/widget-service" failed: parsing error at line 3: invalid token 'beta-ish'. See logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1845678901

josh: classic. suggest we add a lint rule: "No creative semver in YAML". enforceable by policy and shame. :hammer:

ara: can we have a `--forgiveness` flag for the linter? sometimes despair leads to creativity. :seedling:

linus: only acceptable exception: versions that are actual dates (e.g., 2025.01.01). otherwise exile to `notes.md`.

mira: created https://docs.internal/silly-lint-rules#semver-yaml for posterity. includes a new emoji for offenders. :face_with_hand_over_mouth: 

build-bot: noted. auto-tagging offenders with :red_circle: in the PR description.

josh: vote: tabs in YAML — heresy (0) / mildly amusing (1) / immediate exile (2)

participants reacted: josh :thumbsup:, ara :thumbsup:, mira :laughing:, linus :thumbsup:

mira: closing thread — moral of the story: if it looks like poetry, it's not semver.
